en: Sepia-toned studio photograph of a young couple with a baby carriage. The man wears an early-20th‑century uniform and cap, while the woman is dressed in traditional folk-style clothing with a patterned dress, shawl, and head covering. They look down fondly into a wicker pram with large spoked wheels, covered with a fur blanket. Behind them is a painted backdrop of an old European city with church spires and historic buildings, giving the image a nostalgic, romantic feel.
